verdict.rationale: E2B documents an official CLI (e2b) for managing sandboxes and templates. Documented commands cover sandbox create with an interactive terminal, connect, list with --state filtering, exec with --background, shutdown of one or all sandboxes, snapshots, metrics, and project selection. It also supports API-key environment-variable auth for non-interactive CI/agent environments, and a probe confirms the CLI docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows (all evidence is first-party docs).
